name: agy-token-monitor
description: Lightweight Token & Context Monitor for Antigravity (v0.5.0 beta): unified visual refresh (consistent type/spacing/color tokens, calmer status colors, single-color SVG icons, borderless inset panels, dimmed currency/decimals in the cost hero, and per-model color dots), round-scoped interactive Pixel Office (32x32 Main Cat + 24x24 Subagent Cats across 9+1 model personas & 1+8 workstation cap), live tok/s speed, 409.6k/512k context usage monitor & one-click /compact helper, session total tokens & one-click session checkout receipt image copy, Current Session Side Questions summary with one-click open, per-model cache hit rate in both model distribution tables, Top-5 active subagent folding, daily official Google Markdoc model/pricing sync (Gemini 4 flat 1M context & 95% cache rates) with Scheme A canonical model attribution & merging (Gemini 4 Neon, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini 4 Carbon, etc., ledger v5), high-CPU anti-flap OS/env proxy auto-sync & connection pool rebuild, 3-channel release check & SHA-256 CDN hot update with plain-language prompts, bilingual EN/ZH UI, and multi-period usage analytics. | 面向 Antigravity 的轻量级插件（v0.5.0 beta）：全新统一视觉精修（统一字号、间距与配色体系、更克制的状态用色、单色线性 SVG 图标、无嵌套边框内嵌面板、费用主数字弱化币种与小数、与像素工位一致的模型颜色圆点）、按轮次过滤的交互式像素工位（32x32 主猫 + 24x24 子猫、9+1 模型人格与 1+8 工位上限）、实时 Token 测速、409.6k/512k 上下文监控与一键 /compact、会话总 Token 消耗与一键结账收工票根直接复制剪贴板、当前会话 Side Questions 支线独立汇总与一键打开、双表分模型缓存命中率、Top-5 活跃子代理折叠、每日 Google Markdoc 官方模型价格同步（Gemini 4 1M 统一单价与 95% 缓存折扣）与 Scheme A 规范模型归因合并（含 Gemini 4 Neon、Gemini 4 Hydrogen、Gemini 4 Carbon 等及 ledger v5 重建）、高负载防抖动系统与环境变量代理自动同步及连接池自愈、三通道版本检测与 SHA-256 CDN 热更新及通俗化更新提示、中英双语切换与多周期统计。
suggestedPrompts: Open the Token Monitor panel to watch the Pixel Office cats, live tok/s, context usage, and session total tokens
Inspect today, 7-day, 30-day, and all-time token usage and subscription ROI
Check context spikes, prompt cache hit rate, /compact timing, and per-model API cost breakdown
